content.title: Katelyn Rose Downey, Fabien Frankel, Suzanna Son & Emory Cohen Join Arkasha Stevenson’s New A24 Horror Film
content.text: Skip to main content Katelyn Rose Downey, Fabien Frankel, Suzanna Son & Emory Cohen Join Arkasha Stevenson’s New A24 Horror Film L-R: Fabien Frankel, Katelyn Rose Downey, Suzanna Son, and Emory Cohen Getty/Phil Sharp/Courtesy/Larry Busacca EXCLUSIVE: Arkasha Stevenson and Tim Smith’s next A24 horror film is rounding out its cast with Katelyn Rose Downey (The Nun II), Fabien Frankel (Task, House of the Dragon), Suzanna Son (Red Rocket, Monster: The Ed Gein Story), and Emory Cohen (Marty Supreme, The Place Beyond the Pines). Related Stories The currently untitled project follows Stevenson and Smith’s collaboration with A24 on The First Omen, the 2024 prequel starring Nell Tiger Free, Tawfeek Barhom, Sonia Braga, Ralph Inesonand Bill Nighy. They join the previously rumored cast: Josh Hutcherson, Caleb Landry Jones, Whitmer Thomas, Emma Corrin, Havana Rose Liu, Hunter Schafer, and Sophie Wilde. Frank Dillane, who was previously announced as part of the cast, is no longer involved in the project. The film’s logline is under wraps, but it reportedly centers on a bachelor party that spirals into terror. Tim Smith, Harrison Huffman and Christine D’Souza will also produce. Downey is represented by Conway van Gelder Grant in the UK and Principal Entertainment LA in the US. Frankel is represented by Curtis Brown Group, CAA, Luber Roklin and Jackoway Austen Tyerman. Son is represented by CAA, Curate, and Ryan Levin of Jackoway Austen Tyerman.
